batting.name: YK Pathan
batting.dismissal: c Harbhajan Singh b MG Johnson

batting.name: G Gambhir
batting.dismissal: c Harbhajan Singh b PP Ojha

batting.name: JH Kallis
batting.dismissal: c RG Sharma b PP Ojha

batting.name: EJG Morgan
batting.dismissal: c RG Sharma b MG Johnson

batting.name: DR Smith
batting.dismissal: c BB McCullum b SP Narine

batting.name: KA Pollard
batting.dismissal: c MK Tiwary b R Bhatia

balls.text: bowled him and again! that's the leg-stump on the ground to get Malinga his second wicket tonight! it was full again and much Tiwary the batsman was looking to give himself room, but misses by a mile, gone!
another very full delivery that is swinging back into the batsman, manages to get some bat on it and cross over for a single

bowled him, the stumps are flat on the ground as Malinga gets a yorker right! it was the best ball he's bowled tonight and Tiwary was giving himself a lot of room to hit it away, he misses and the ball gets the stumps' scalp!
another yorker that's speared into the batsman, beats him and hits pads, goes across for a leg-bye
slower one outside the off stump, it never rose too much and he was looking to flay it away, misses easily
yorker length and swinging back into the batsman, tapped to the long-on area for a single
fuller on the off stump and it's played away to the leg side for a run
shorter in length and does not get to the batsman, was bowled from yards behind the stumps, and the pull gets to the deep square-leg region
very short and slow too, was looking to pull it away, misses and it goes through to the keeper
short of length and he looks to run down the track, almost beaten by the bounce but is able to play it down, beats the square-leg inside the circle and they are able to get back for the third
fuller this time but angling into the batsman, driven to long-on for a single
fuller, slower and that's chipped over the long-off for a four, MJ tried to get close but misses
gone, caught by the captain! shorter, slower and that's top-edged to Rohit Sharma at mid-wicket! he was looking to pull it away but did not get it off the middle

full on his pads and that's been flicked away in the gap in the long-leg region, Harbhajan was looking to dive there but to no avail, he seems to have injured his shoulder too, he's down and the physio's taking a look at him
but this time its pounded over the long-on region for a six! it was very full from MJ and Morgan tees off to get the maximum
well bowled that! Morgan was looking to scoop it over the keeper but Mitchell watched him till the last second, dug it in so short that he was unable to get any bat on it
slower, 118 km/hr, very full, takes it as a full-toss and driven through the covers for a single
outside the off stump and thats been carved away to the deep extra-cover region, Harbhajan runs across and stops it from going to the fence
walks down the track and thrashes it through mid-wicket for a four, spoils what was a good over to begin things
big appeal after Tiwary tries to hoick it across the line, it hits his back pad alright, but it was easily missing the leg stump
fullish on his pads and he's able to drive it down to long-on for only a single
slower and on a length, he was looking to walk across and tap it to fine-leg for a single
this is not as full, slower too and chopped to the point fielder for a single
yorker attempted but it turns into a full-toss, was looking to hammer it through the leg-side but the leading edge goes to the point fielder, not on full though
tries to sweep it away, it's a tad slower this time, misses the outside edge
and this time he goes down the track, it's full enough for Tiwary to do that and he's able to hammer it flat over the bowler for a six
that's short and gets some treatment, rocks back on to his back foot and spanks it away, through wide long-on
shimmy down the pitch and tapped it away to wide long-on for a couple of runs
well bowled and almost gone! it was turning back into the batsman and he was drifting down the track, hits the pads and flies off towards the keeper, a single leg-bye results
googly, leaves the left-hander who was looking to slog it away, misses the outside edge
slower one, a very slow ball and Tiwary had decided to tonk it into another city, misses by a mile and that ends a very good over, just one from it
on a good length on the off stump and he's got his front out and taps it down the ground for a single
edged and it slides through to the keeper on a couple of bounces, that's four dot balls in a row
beaten outside the off stump! it was held across the seam and the batsman was beaten by the lack of pace
fuller on the off stump and for the second time he defends on the front foot, that's a couple of dots, what will he do next
fuller on the off stump and Morgan is quickly on to the front foot, defends it back to the bowler
short of length this time and is able to push it through the mid-wicket region, timed very well by Morgan and it almost beats Harbhajan Singh at deep mid-wicket, they come back for the third
spinning back into the left-hander, he plays forward and pushes it to the leg side, fielder inside the circle fields it
goes down the track and drives it down to long-on for a single
sweeps and sweeps hard, straight to the backward square-leg fielder for a single
fuller on the off stump and driven it to the right of the bowler, who fields it well
another reverse sweep, not off the middle of the bat but just beats the in-fielder at short third-man, Lasith Malinga's there but it eludes him
fuller from Harbhajan and it's hit back in air, to the bowler's right and they are off for a single
reverse swept for a four! it was from round the stumps and drifting on to his pads, Morgan was quick to slap it away
short of length from Bhajji and outside the off, flat bats it to the mid-wicket region for a single
tries to cut it away, but misses it en route the keeper
fullish on the middle stump and he's skipped down the track and driven to the wide long-on fielder, they come back for the second
round the stumps and on his pads, tapped away to fine-leg for a single

outside the off stump and he was looking to go towards the off side and defend, beats the inside edge of the bat and slips through to the keeper, who misses it and they are able to rush across for a bye
on the middle stump and tapped it away to the leg side
gone this time, caught in the covers! it was fuller and Kallis wanted to drill it through the covers, but gets it straight to the captain who takes it happily, three down
slower from Ojha as Tiwary was looking to work him inside out, in the end taps it to the off side for a single
fuller and slower and this is driven down to long-off for a single to Mitchell
opens his stance up a tad and is able to crack it through the point region for a couple of runs
quicker, flatter and on the off stump, Kallis drives it like he would against a medium pacer and gets a single to the sweeper fielder
taps it to the off side and wants to run off for a single, sent back by the non-striker
goes down the track but gets too close to the ball and is only able to flick it away to the deep square-leg region for a single
length ball and bit of turn away from the bat, driven through to long-off for a single
that's a googly, Kallis reads it well and pulls it over mid-wicket, Rayadu runs to his left and manages to stop it from getting to the fence
fuller and on his pads, easily tucked down to long-on, poor fielding by Malinga, who makes a clumsy effort at sliding at it, easily allows them a couple of runs
a tad quicker and he opens the face of the bat and taps it to the pont region
that's tossed up yet again and Kallis gets a good chunk of the bat on it while driving it down the ground for a single
flights it up yet again and it's driven down to long-off for a single
drives it through the covers for a single
dropped! well bowled by the bowler, tosses it up and Kallis goes over the top and gets to long-off where Johnson floors a reasonably easy one
floats it up to the bat and Kallis is only able to drive it back to the bowler
fullish on the middle and he gets his bat and pad out, defends it to the off side
slower this time from Chahal and it's driven down to long-off for a single
fuller on the off stump, hardly any turn and Kallis plays it through to the backward point region
shorter in length and he taps it to the short cover region, not for runs
fuller and he's quickly on to his front foot, drives it to long-off for a single
cut away hard and through the in-field for a four! Harbhajan at point, dives over the ball

gone, caught! he wanted to continue that aggressive route again but Gambhir's holed out in the covers. Seems like he was beaten by the flight, was looking to slog it over mid-wicket but it gets an outside edge and it floats up to Harbhajan who grabs his second catch
some turn, some bounce and defeats GG's on the cut shot, gets an inside edge
driven through the covers for a single this time
shorter from the bowler, and slower too and Gambhir was looking to cut it hard, mistimed and it flies in the air but in the gap for a single
slows it down even further and the ball turns away from the batsman, who opens the face of the bat and rushes off for a quick single, fielder hits the striker end's stumps but GG's in
slower, fuller and on the pads, tapped to the mid-wicket fielder
edged it looks like, but too low and quick for Karthik to bend down, hits his pads and that ends an excellent Pollard over
slower, fuller and driven to extra-cover, straight to the fielder
full and on the off stump, drives it to mid-off for a quickly taken single, Malinga was looking to throw down the non-striking stumps but he was in
slower on the off stump, GG has to adjust his stroke and manages to play it through the point region for a single
fullish this time and driven to the right of Pollard and who goes around and fields
short of length outside the off stump and he opens the face of the bat and gets it through the backward point region for a couple of runs
fuller on the off stump and driven straight to the cover fielder, not for runs though
fuller on the pads and driven through the leg side for a single to Pollard at deep mid-wicket
quicker, bit of width but no turn back into GG, cut hard but fielded well by Smith
fuller on the middle stump and flicked away to the leg side for a single
and tries to go down the track and smack it again, mistimed a little and goes to deep square-leg for a single
slapped for a four! outside the off stump, gives him room and GG slog sweeps it through mid-wicket for a four!
short of length and pushed into the covers, not for runs though
on his pads and easily tucked away to the leg side, the fine-leg is up in the circle but Mitch fields well there
almost a wicket! it was a leading edge from Gambhir and Malinga needed to dive to his right if he had any chance of even coming close to touching the ball, survives!
he continues to pitch it shorter but this is more cramping than the first ball and he's only able to tuck it to the leg side for a single
short of length and on the off stump, he is pushed on to the back foot before tapping it to mid-off for a single
bad ball, lot of width from Malinga and Kallis throws his bat at it, crashes it through the backward point region for a four, 50 comes up for KKR!
fuller on the off stump and drives it well to the mid-off region but fielded well by Harbhajan and that's a single
fuller and outside the off stump, he goes for a drive but straight to the mid-off region
and this one keeps a tad low, angling outside the off stump and Kallis defends it to the off side
shortish in length this time and he is looking to play it through the point region, gets it to the fielder
fuller, slower that usual, and he pushes it to the covers, GG wanted a single from the non-striker's end but he's sent back
short of length and coming in with the angle, opens the face of the bat through to the backward point region for a single

short of length this time, bit of a surprise delivery or that is what Malinga would have thought anyway, but the batsman is quick to rock back and smash it through the backward square-leg region for a four!
on the middle stump and Gambhir is pushed to the back foot, is able to turn it to short fine-leg for a single
and that's not as short as Kallis would have liked to believe, he was playing it off the back foot and gets an inside edge, Gambhir is able to call him through for a quick single
length outside the off stump and Kallis goes back and drives it back to the bowler who fields on his follow-through
gone, thrashed away! it was on a length and Kallis was having no more of those defensive strokes, it's been cracked through the covers for a four!
short of length, outside the off and it's pushed to the covers where it goes straight to the fielder
short of length and the batsman is able to tap it to the leg side for a single
fullish on the middle stump this time and GG is able to push it through mid-wicket, good outfield too and almost makes it to the fence
full, swinging away from the bat and that's been drilled through the covers for a four! GG is sprinting away here as well!
short of length on the middle stump and it's tucked around the corner for a single to square-leg
outside the off stump from over the wicket, on a good length and Kallis lets it go through to the keeper

edged and taken, Mitchell Johnson has taken the wicket and Harbhajan Singh is the catcher and I wonder whether Rohit would be wondering why he didn't start with the quicker bowler. was on a length and angling away from the batsman, he tries to get his bat down hard and the outside edge flies to the first slip, first blood
that's a very over-pitched ball and that's a very wide ball too, way outside the off and the batsman has nothing to do with it
stop the press, there's a dot! it was short and he wanted to cut it away, hits it quite hard and there's no run
and it goes for a six. Was always going to happen with a batsman like Gambhir on strike, it was floated up very full and he clears his foot and banishes it over long-on
it gets worse for Harbhajan, this was flatter, fuller and swept well but for a single, but wait a minute, it's also a no-ball, and in turn a Free Hit!
and now, it is a six! fuller on the off stump and he bludgeons it over long-off for a six! Pathan's started like he's been watching a lot of Gayle!
three in a row! what a start! he has thrown his bat at it again, swept it to backward square-leg for the third in three balls
another four, second in a row! it was flighted just that little bit and he goes for the sweep, beats the in-field and gets it to deep square-leg for a four
edged and through the slips for a four! what a start, he was looking to defend at it and the outside edge flies off the bat and eludes the right of the first slipper, Rohit in action

full-toss and Rayadu has hit it over extra-cover for a four! Bhatia seemed to have come up with the plan of bowling it well full but the batsmen read him well last three balls, was a full-toss this time from the bowler and the batsman had hopped down the track to smack it through to the fence and win it for the side
very full but quicker too, outside the off stump and driven down the ground for a single

whoa, what a shot, what an amazing shot from a man who has been under pressure all night! it was slightly fuller from Bhatia and he gave it the full swing of the bat, hits the middle and it's gone all the way over the mid-wicket fence!
goes down the track and hits it straight to the long-off fielder, seems to have taken it on the bounce, on the half-volley and Tiwary seems to have hurt himself there, just a single there though

on his pads and he's spooned it straight to the fielder! was a slower one, almost a leg-spinner and Pollard was looking to smash it over the leg side, but is beaten by the pace, it goes high up in the air and Tiwary takes that very easily!

short of length and he was looking to drive it on the up to long-off, went straight to the fielder but Pollard's run really quickly to almost lap his partner! gets back for the second run and in time too, retains the strike as well
slogged away but there's no pace on the ball and hence, no pace on the shot either, rolls over to the deep square-leg area for a single
angles back into the batsman who opens the face of the bat and guides it to backward point for a single
another one that's very wide outside the off stump, wide enough to be called but he goes for a slog, gets it to long-on for a single
fuller and hes lying on his back foot, opens the face of the bat to the short third-man region for a single, bit of a fumble form Pathan again!
wide outside the off and that should have been left alone, instead he goes for a slash and hits it straight to the fielder, Pathan, at the sweeper region and a misfield allows them to get a second
short of length and Rayadu pulls it away to the backward square-leg for a single
fuller from the bowler and easily drilled down the ground for a single to long-on
short of length and driven back to the bowler, fielded well by SS
and Pollard's taken to SS immediately, it was very full from the bowler and the batsman did not have a huge swing at it, hits it over long-on for the maximum
does not turn and he gets a leading edge trying to work it to the leg side, quick-fire single
shorter and on his pads, easily tucked away to the deep square-leg region for a single

gone, caught and bowled! it was turning back into the batsman and the ball seems to have never come on to the bat, Rohit was on the back foot way before he should have been and the defensive stroke leads to the ball popping up for Narine to take an easy catch to his left
looks to pull it away but misses, to the keeper
paddle sweep and that's gone for a four! that was fuller from Narine and he's able to get it away to the fine-leg fence
fuller and he's tucked it away to the leg side for a single, trickles down to the deep square-leg for a run
on to the back foot and is easily punched through to wide long-on for a couple of runs now
shorter, wider and cut hard, through the covers for a single only

shorter in length again and Pollard plays this smartly, he whips it towards the fine-leg region but the fielder is up inside the circle, which means that both, the short fine-leg and the deep square-leg have to chase it down and they are able to come back for the second
shorter and slower outside the off stump, he wants to punch it through the extra-cover area but gets it straight to the fielder there
fuller on his pads and he chips it to the leg side, between long-on and mid-wicket for a couple of runs
slower, shorter, wants to pull it away but does not get any timing on it, pulled to the fielder at deep square-leg for a single
that's very wide outside the off and would have been given, but he goes for a tennis forehand and gets it straight down the ground for a couple of runs
and now Balaji is trying to bowl at Bhatia's speeds, the ball just does not come on to the bat and he's already played the stroke twice, beats the outside edge

outside edge for Pollard to end an excellent over from Narine, he was looking to hit a forceful stroke but gets nowhere near the middle and it runs away to the short third-man fielder where Balaji misfields
fuller from Narine and his countryman plays it back to the bowler, defended well
quicker and on the off stump, pushed to the off side and they are off for a quick single
bat and pad together and on the back foot, pushes it to the deep square-leg fielder for a single
off spinner that's very short and he wants to pull it away, but does not go too hard at him, gets it to deep square-leg for a single
outside the off stump, tries to tap it through the off side but the edge runs through to the short third-man
fuller from Bhatia now and he clips it off his foot, single to fine-leg
on his pads and he flicks it away to the deep mid-wicket region for another single now
slow, very, very slow and the batsman has to wait for it before trying to whip it away, gets an inside edge
slowish, cuts it across the seam and easily tapped down the ground for a single
short of length and tapped it to the leg side for a single

whoa, what happened there! it was fuller and Pollard wanted to hit it through the line, the ball never came on and it was going straight to the fielder, Baz, at long-off who loses sight of the ball and lets it go through! goes through for a one-bounce four, he looks to have lost the ball in the lights

okay, that's not the best of deliveries from a spinner, was looking to go down the pitch and SS drops it very short, almost would have been a bouncer had the bowler got some pace on it, easily pulled away over the deep square-leg region for the second six of the over, and despite catches of "catch it" it was hit long and hard!
shorter immediately, and it's tapped back to the bowler
was floated up in the air and he goes down the track and hits it beautifully over the bowler's head for a six!
goes down the track to drive it through the covers but gets straight to the fielder at short cover, Bhatia does well there
sharp turn back into the batsman, he was not sure whether to go forward or play back, the inside edge gets to the leg side for a single
reaches out to the delivery that's outside the off stump and pushes it to the leg side for a single
tries to cramp him for room, is on his pads and easily tucked to the mid-wicket area for a single
outside edge and it goes straight to the short third-man fielder, he was looking to push it through the covers
flat-batted and pushed to the leg side, gets an edge for a single
inside edge and rolls over to the very fine, fine-leg fence for a four, the edge could have gone anywhere including the stumps, but misses the stumps by a whisker!
on his pads and that's deftly worked away to the leg side for a single
shimmies down the pitch and pushes it down the ground for a single
fuller on the middle stump and it's been spooned high up in the air, gets more from the bottom of the bat and it goes to McCullum who almost makes a mess of it, catches it in the end!
on the off stump and on a good length, it was tapped to the off side for a single
an off spinner, coming back into the batsman, pushed through the covers for a single
shorter in length and Smith continues to defend at it, taps it to the off side
is on the back foot, wants to defend at it and does it very cautiously
gets it fuller on the middle stump, he taps it to the leg side for a single
a slower one at sub-100 km/hr speeds, short of length too and tapped gently down the ground for a single
short of length from Bhatia and it's punched it back to the bowler
short of length at 95 km/hr and he plays it across to the leg side for a single
fuller from the bowler and it's worked around to long-on for a single
slower from Bhatia and the ball just does not come on to the bat, gets an inside edge
short of length and it's pushed back down the ground for a single, the long-off converges across to the ball
pulls his length back a little, is able to play it around to the leg side for a single
...but this time he does not miss, this was exactly the shot he wanted to play last ball except that this time it was lot fuller and he was able to swing it away from the middle
wants to slog it over long-on, the turn away from the batsman beats the bat and goes to the keeper
flicked away to the leg side for a single, from the back foot
down the wicket he comes but the ball's a tad slower than he would have liked, gets some bat on it to the leg side for a single
fuller on the middle stump, gets an inside edge and it rolls away to the leg side for a single
short of length and he is able to work it away to the leg side for a single

gone, given out lbw! he was playing him from the back-foot and the ball was angling into the batsman, seems to have hit the batsman a tad higher than needed but the ump's finger was quickly up and DK sent on his way!
on the off stump and he's quickly on to his back foot, just pushed to the leg side for a single, the bowler has to rush across to field
taps it to the leg side and they are away for a single but Karthik wants to come back for the second which they do...bringing up Smith's fifty! Good knock this!
and now he's hit him over mid-wicket for a six! that was not too floated up but he did well to free his arms up and smash it for the maximum
outside the off stump, was a tad shorter in length and he was first looking to smack it across but changed his shot and cuts it through the covers
defended to the off side, straight to the fielder
outside the off stump and he was looking to hit it against the turn, lot of bottom hand there, but gets it to the long-on fielder
round the stumps, on the middle and tucked away to the leg side for a single
short of good length and he was going back, the ball stops on him and it flies to the right of the bowler, was in the air but away
slightly shorter than before, on a good length and defended to the off side
very full and Smith has blasted it out of his sight, hits it through mid-wicket for a maximum!
width and Karthik punches is through the covers and for a four! what a start to Karthik's innings, who's been attempting to run at every possible chance and now this shot
heaved it away to the leg side, was hit hard and the fielder needed to put in the dive and restricts them to three, good running from Karthik as well
swept away and for a four through the backward square-leg region, the fielders were inside the circle
tapped to the mid-wicket fielder, Morgan fields well and tries to throw down the stumps at Karthik's ends
down the leg side from round the stumps, an appeal for a catch but it seems to have come off the pads
on the middle stump and Karthik was shimmying down the track, pushed to the right of the bowler and are away for a quick one
shorter, quicker and tucked away to the leg side for a single, Karthik's off the mark

bowled him, middle stump flattened! this was one of the first few deliveries that were pitched up to the bat, not very full but full enough to get Tendulkar to play through the off side, the ball spins back into the batsman and beats the inside edge, gone, bowled without scoring too many.
short of length yet again and is cut hard to the off side, but straight to the fielder
shorter on the off stump, no turn for Narine and it's pushed to the off side
short from Narine and it is punched down the ground for a single
on his pads and tapped away to square-leg, straight to the fielder, the batsman is batting on the off-stump there
shorter but slower and is easily tucked away to mid-wicket for a single off the last ball of the over, pinches the strike yet again
and again! he tries to push it further on to the bat and Smith seemed to be waiting for it, slams it over the long-on fence for a second six in as many balls
short from Abdulla and smacked it over mid-wicket for a six, it was a length ball and flatter too, allowing him to smash it away
fuller from the bowler and he gets the bat and pad out, defended back to the bowler
goes down the pitch and nurdles it away for a single
shorter in length and he's able to tuck it down to the leg side for a single
fuller on his pads and he taps it to mid-wicket for a single to retain strike yet again
gets bit of an inside edge and he gets it a single to mid-wicket
down the pitch and there's a huge, huge appeal for lbw! hits flush on his pads, but seemed to be going down the leg-side there
short of length and he was looking to cut it, gets an inside edge and they are away for a very quick single
well fielded by McLaren at the point region, the fielder was a couple of yards away but dives to his left and fields well
on his pads and that's glanced down to fine-leg for a four, hits his pads and rolls over to the fence
on the length and tapped to mid-on for a single, which means that Tendulkar's yet to get strike again
down the pads, he tries to sweep it away but is easily beaten, five dots in a row
he was looking to play it off the back foot, gets bit of a leading edge through to the off side
ooh, almost a wicket! beats the outside of the bat and misses the stumps as well, just by a whisker
some turn from Abdulla, turning away from the bat, hits the outside edge and rolls over to backward point
he throws the bat at it and misses easily, beats the outside the edge, no foot movement
comes back into the batsman, gets bit of an inside edge and they are off for a quickly taken single, Balaji was looking to dart towards the ball and throw it at Tendulkar's end but does not get close
darting into the batsman, fuller too and the outside edge runs through to the point fielder
on the off stump and driven down to mid-off, not for runs though
on a good length and on the middle stump line, it was jagging back into the batsman but it was also keeping a tad low, gets his bat down in time
fuller on the off stump and Smith goes over the in-field, hits through the extra-cover region and it trickles into the fence for a four
outside the off stump and he lets it go through to the keeper, shoulders arms!
